title: Rippers Unmasked — Classes & Skills
description: The Rippers Unmasked class corpus as native Foundry Item packs the GM drags onto Project FU sheets: type:class Items for every Rippers class, their class skills as UUID-linked type:skill Items, and heroic skills as type:heroic Items with their requirements listed. Ships a browsable JournalEntry Player Reference pack (all 68 classes + shared-subsystem notes as readable prose). Original campaign content, layered on Project FU. A personal-table module — not for redistribution.

rippers-compendium.note: [v0.4.3 flat-damage re-emit, pre-release] Austin+god corrected my earlier hasDamage:false call: FU HAS native flat damage via hrZero (verified in FoundryVTT-Fabula-Ultima-dev spell-data-model.mjs:94-95 useWeapon.hrZero.value + :232 modifyHrZero; FU.damageTypes has native untyped). So the two FIXED-amount spells now emit as REAL flat damage: Pyroclastic Column hasDamage:true value:50 type:fire useWeapon.hrZero.value:true; The Perihelion hasDamage:true value:60 type:untyped hrZero:true (untyped = FU native typeless). Source data (spells-source.json) updated to carry the flat value+hrZero (values from the printed effect the _gap prose already recorded; god-authorized). Crosswind/The Pit are HR-based ((HR+5) x2), NOT flat — hrZero stays FALSE (making them flat would wrongly drop the HR); only their 2nd instance is unrepresented (unchanged, flagged). The Four Winds (5 sequential different-type instances) stays hasDamage:false — FU spells hold a SINGLE rollInfo.damage block, no multi-instance — full effect in description + flagged. Build report still surfaces 9 non-representable/lossy spells; none ships a fabricated number. --- [v0.4.3 fidelity fix, pre-release] Coroner caught a transform bug: 3 spells with source damage.value:null (FIXED, non-(HR+N) amounts — Pyroclastic Column 50/30, The Perihelion 60/40, The Four Winds sequential 10s) were coerced null->0 and shipped as bogus (HR+0) spells (two with real types, so they didn t even trip the type-blank flag). Fixed the ?? 0 fallback: only a concrete numeric value emits as representable damage; a fixed-amount spell now emits hasDamage:false (rep call (b) — FU rollInfo.damage is always HR+value, so a flat amount is only correct as no-roll + the amount in the description prose, already verbatim) and hasRoll:false, and is flagged. Build report now surfaces ALL 9 non-representable/lossy spells (3 value-null + 4 type-blank + Crosswind/The Pit multi-instance); none ships a fabricated number. --- v0.4.3 (PACK 4 — SPELLS; unblocks rippers-guise spell auto-materialization): emits 81 type:spell Items from data/spells-source.json (Compiler; 6 class disciplines: elementalism/entropism/illusion + 3 more), on the same snapshot-driven pattern as skills/heroics. Each spell carries flags.rippers-compendium.{spellKey, discipline, classKey, grantingSkillKey, perTarget, heroic} so the guise can build a grantingSkillKey→spells map for its picker and auto-stamp picked spells on bind. FU field paths per spells-source _meta: mpCost.value/target.value (String), duration.value (enum), isOffensive.value (Boolean), rollInfo.damage.hasDamage/type/value (HR added at cast). rollInfo.attributes is NOT written (the dataset carries no per-spell attribute pairings; inventing barred; FU SpellDataModel supplies defaults). 5 spells have an unresolved (choose/multi) damage type — left BLANK + ⚠ flagged, never invented. Read ALONGSIDE db-snapshot, not folded into it (spells are authored source, not DB rows — spells-source _meta sanctions this). NOT auto-stampable and excluded from class_spells (documented in-source): Dancer dances (structural gap — no mpCost/target, duration outside the FU enum; needs a ruling), NPC-design spells (GM toolkit), Vivisectionist (runtime Spell Mimic, no static list). New compendium pack spells declared. --- v0.4.1: FIX — the v0.4.0 player-reference LevelDB shipped inconsistent (CURRENT/MANIFEST pointed at a stale .ldb lineage from in-place recompiles), so Foundry v13 failed to open it ("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading packData)"). tools/pack.mjs now clears each target pack dir before compiling, so every pack ships a clean single-manifest LevelDB. Content unchanged. --- Items validate against Project FU's class/skill/heroic DataModels (packs system:projectfu). The player-reference JournalEntry pack renders the verbatim player binder — 68 classes + shared-subsystem notes — as browsable in-world prose (folders: Innate Only / Guise / Appendix), built from lodge-docs/COMPENDIUM-player-reference.md by tools/build-journals.mjs; formatting-only, no rules edits (editorial ✎/⚠/⛔ glyph marks stripped, all prose incl. house rulings kept). v0.4.0 RECONCILED the appendix to Compendium2.pdf Part V (Austin's authority): 8 reference notes (Heroics · Arcana Registry · Arcanum · Keystones · Torments · Personal Vehicle · NPC Spells [See-You-Later/Unexpected-Ally folded in] · Pressure and Stagger [new, extracted from the PDF p180–183]). The PDF's class bodies + all 271 numbered SL caps verify identical to the .md (the .md is the PDF's own upstream source), so names/bodies/caps are unchanged. No FU content is redistributed; no automation code.
